InTraC Knowledge Base

The central hub for finding, analysing and disseminating data of the InTraC CRC. It provides training, service and a community for getting in touch with fellow data analysis experts.

Workflows

Unified data analysis workflows for genomics data

Provide unified interoperable omics workflows built on Nextflow and nf-core, ensuring reproducibility across environments.

Training

Training resources to get up to speed with data analysis

Courses from beginner to advanced for all InTraC researchers. Learn R/Python, Linux/HPC, single-cell analysis, multi-omics integration, and more.

View courses →

Data Management

Data management in the InTraC knowledge base

FAIR-compliant data management for all consortium projects. Integrates heterogeneous omics datasets from humans and animal species with standardised metadata schemas, cross-species integration, and version control.

Learn more →

Analysis Platform

The interactive InTraC data analysis platform

Leverage breakthroughs in large language models to provide a tailored interactive system for complex multi-omics queries and target discovery. Natural language queries in English and German, cross-project exploration, and interactive visualisation.

Try the platform →

Data analysis services

Provide consulting and integrative bioinformatic data analysis service to enable researchers to analyse, interpret, and integrate data across projects.
